Good morning, friends. **Mehdi** here. I went on '[Piers Morgan
Uncensored](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VXthKe5mEAM&t=4190s)' yesterday
and, painfully, Piers ended our interview insisting I - a Liverpool fan -
congratulate him - an Arsenal fan - for his team winning the Premier League
after 22 years. I reluctantly [did
so](https://x.com/PiersUncensored/status/2057205976005025900). Sorry.

Anyways, in today's** 'First Draft,' Jeff Bezos** reminds us that he has no
principles and no shame; **Democrats** mount a fightback against **Donald
Trump 's** most crazily corrupt act _ever_ ; and **Benjamin Netanyahu** wants
us to believe that **Itamar Ben-Gvir** doesn't represent Israel or its values
(_LOL!_).

# **' Jeff Bozo'**

[![](https://substackcdn.com/image/fetch/$s_!Xs9v!,w_1456,c_limit,f_auto,q_auto:good,fl_progressive:steep/https%3A%2F%2Fsubstack-

post-
media.s3.amazonaws.com%2Fpublic%2Fimages%2F7704f7c2-d8ad-41d4-9cb2-414a592e8544_738x421.png)_Amazon
founder Jeff Bezos speaks to CNBC at his Blue Origin Rocket Factory in Merritt
Island, Florida. Picture: Screenshot._

Do you remember what Donald Trump used to
[call](https://x.com/realDonaldTrump/status/1084627451983073280) Amazon
founder and _Washington Post_ owner Jeff Bezos during his first term as
President? I do.

**" Jeff Bozo."**

Second-term Trump and the [fourth-richest man](https://www.forbes.com/real-
time-billionaires/) in the world now get along _much better_ than they did
before. Because Bezos, like [so
many](https://www.latimes.com/business/story/2025-02-03/mark-zuckerberg-once-
a-trump-critic-cozies-up-to-the-president) [other
billionaire](https://abcnews.com/US/openais-sam-altman-warned-america-trump-
now-partnering/story?id=118145337) tech moguls, has gone from [loudly
criticizing](https://www.politico.com/story/2018/09/13/jeff-bezos-trump-
amazon-washington-post-787219) the president to shamelessly capitulating to
him.

On Wednesday, in an [interview](https://www.cnbc.com/video/2026/05/20/watch-
cnbcs-full-interview-with-amazon-founder-jeff-bezos.html) with CNBC's Andrew
Ross Sorkin, Bezos fawned over the president,
[saying](https://x.com/atrupar/status/2057086688237613359) **" Trump has lots
of good ideas"** and **" you have to give him credit where credit is due." **
